EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Last week, a member of our support team tried contacting you to assist with this request. They left a message for you at that time. Because we have not heard back from you since then, we want to touch base to see if you are still in need of assistance with this. If so, please call 800-314-8223 at your convenience and reference this {!Case.CaseNumber}. A member of our live support team will be happy to assist.
Thank you in advance,
Technical Support Team 8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
